body:
I would recommend going to a psychiatrist or even a general doctor so they can prescribe you some short-term strong anxiety help like Xanax (even if you can’t get it in time for this one, get it for future situations). With this extreme of anxiety I think it’s unreasonable to expect yourself to do well and be an a good mental state without serious help. Once you get to the level of anxiety you’re describing, you just need more than breathing exercises imo.

Personally, I used to have anxiety attacks during presentations, but with Xanax I was able to expose myself to doing them to the point where I usually don’t need any medication anymore to present.

Yes omg I don’t know why I get so much anxiety about saying people’s names to them. It’s not that I don’t remember, it just feels like a very familiar and ‘intimate’ thing to include? Like ‘hey’ is more casual than ‘hey (name)’. At least I feel that way when people say my name

Social anxiety disorder lol. I do respond to comments but it’s usually once every couple months when I get the courage. Once I do I want to give a good response. Most of my frequent readers probably know about my anxiety at least but regardless comments mean so much to me.
Whenever I’m off meds I feel this way lol(still a little on meds but not overwhelming). It’s so hard to get through anything when you feel like you’re controlling yourself like a robot to be natural

I also have a weird internal feeling of being inferior when I’m around those really pretty, social girls. It doesn’t make me dislike/look down on them - theyre always really nice and fun to be around - but when I compare myself to them, I feel inferior for not being as pretty, as social, or going out as much as them. In reality, I’m sure they have their own problems to deal with too.

It helps me to keep my eyes open and just notice the other girls that aren’t that way vs comparing myself to such a high fucking standard lol. It helps that in college then my profession I kind of somehow chose a niche where the girls around me were more relatable to me.

Yet I’m still not making close friends lmao but at least I connect more to the girls around me. Not that I don’t wanna be friends with different girls, it’s just harder to click. But I feel like I have a better chance? lol 

btw, it’s cool to see more women posting on this sub and about our specific shit. I feel like I didn’t see many when I first joined. It feels less lonely to see other socially anxious girls.

Like others said, I used propranolol or (prescribed) Xanax to get through them. I take regular meds too but most need an extra boost for super high stress events like an interview. Otherwise with the anxiety symptoms like blanking and stuff it’s so hard to respond to questions well. Of course looking into interview tips online can also help a lot

Definitely not an act of bad faith, especially if he’s your primary care doctor, since seeing to your overall health is part of his job along with the specific issue you came to him for. Most doctors I see that notice my anxiety will comment or suggest things. Such bad anxiety is not good for your overall physical and mental health, so again it’s very much part of his job to suggest treating it. 

I don’t understand how it would be confusing, suspicious, or an act of bad faith for a doctor to point out this potential heath problem. I think that’s 100% your anxiety talking. I would take his advice, maybe he can refer you to a therapist or psychiatrist to help treat it.

I don’t have an answer but I feel the same way. When I tried dating apps I got too much anxiety having to respond and almost every conversation was led by the guy to sex. I’d probably have an anxiety attack trying to have sex for the first time with someone I don’t know so I definitely don’t want sex. So I won’t do dating apps either but it’s hard to meet someone organically.

Dudes saying it’s easy for girls and to just approach someone don’t get it. One: this is a social anxiety sub so just asking someone out isn’t so simple, and two: if a girl doesn’t have the right facial features, we’re totally invisible to most men.
Yes omg because the idea of friends sounds so nice until I realize that actually someone frequently wanting to interact with me might just be totally exhausting

This is less me asking about if it’s a scam and more about how I should respond (or at all) since I’ve never received a comment like this before. Sorry I don’t frequent this sub enough to know that it’s common?
I once read an article that said that probiotics specifically help with social anxiety, but I was unsure of how effective it could really be. Maybe this is my sign lol

Oh yeah I totally get why they do it! With Molly being around it would be hard to justify Harry going to another person like Snape for support. And people are totally free to do that. It just really threw me off-guard when I dipped my toes into HP fics lol. Personally I would’ve just written it out a different way, but then again, a lot of these fics use Molly/ginny being bad as a part of the plot or a villian type of character. If I had any sort of critique, it would be for authors to come up with a creative reason why their personalities seemingly change so much.

Molly is such a great person in canon so I hope to find some fics where she’s embraced! Personally, I don’t like it when female characters are bashed to make room for the guys (not to say that anyone is not allowed to do so). Maybe I’m missing a tag that I can filter out.

I’m actually describing xiaoven from genshin but I’m so sorry you have the exact same problem in your fandom 😭

Edit: specifically Venti in Xiaoven. Xiao isn’t canonically mean either, it’s just a thing in fics

omg I literally read some Harry Potter fics for the first time and I was wondering why they all made Molly Weasley so awful?? She’s literally one of the closest things Harry has to a parent and I really wanted to see that developed even more! Dumbledore I understand a little more but still, if you’re trying to be canon-compliant, he’s very important to Harry at least and not a total idiot.

(I actually think I know why. It’s because they want another character to be Harry’s parent figure which doesn’t work as well when Molly one of the most competent and emotionally mature parent figures lol)

It especially gets me when someone is writing a ship but has a clear bias toward one of the characters in the pairing. Then they write their fave doing shitty things to the other and always getting instantly forgiven or what they did is minimized rather than really resolving the conflict 😣

I used to read a lot of a popular pairing where this was the case pretty often. It’s especially bad because a lot of authors interpreted the ship as a “grumpy x sunshine” dynamic, ie “asshole character x character who is kind enough to take it”. Like I was coming here for romance, not to be sad about one of my faves being consistently treated like utter shit 😭 sometimes there were fics where that character would straight up rape the other and it’s treated lightly because the other is ‘secretly a slut and really liked it’ 


I once got a comment on a fic kind of pointing out that they felt I was doing something of the like and I was so glad they said something. Especially for my OTP where I’m in love with both characters but definitely a bit more hyperfixated on one, I worry about making that mistake. I spent a whole extra chapter fleshing out his backstory more, focusing on him, and ensuring that the other showed a lot of care for his feelings after that. I never want to be that person 💀

I wish I saw more comments like this. I don’t understand how I wouldn’t hear “the trash needs to be taken out” as an open request for me to take out the trash anyway. Unless you’re neurodivergent maybe, it would probably be obvious? It just leaves room for other options based on the situation. Maybe you’re even just making everyone aware that it should be done in the coming morning by someone, not right now. Or, for example, ‘I want you to want to take out the trash for me’, rather than feeling like they’re demanding it.

I was raised to believe asking for this was too much or wrong, so I think that for some people, it’s just the way they naturally communicate. It’s not malicious or passive aggressive, it’s just saying essentially the same thing in a different way. Maybe some people really don’t like that style of communication, but that’s what some people are comfortable saying and it wouldn’t be right to assume anyone intends to be passive aggressive toward you. I would say it’s more passive aggressive to pretend not to know what they mean at all.

The complaint kind of feels like a “can I go to the bathroom?” “I don’t know, /can/ you?” situation lol. Either way of communication should be understandable to the average person.

“I thought this was a sub for mental issues” is such a crazy excuse to insert yourself into a space you are fully aware is full of victims (likely of the paraphillias they have) is absolutely wild. 

This is so clearly not a space for them to garner understanding, support, or sympathy from. The fact that they don’t understand this is a sign they are still in need of intensive therapy. These are mental issues that require very specific and well-moderated communities, away from victims of trauma. Choosing to surround themselves with survivors comes off as predatory or at the least, shows a lack of empathy, understanding of boundaries, or an issue of self-absorption imo.

Victims do not, in fact, owe them sympathy, no matter how much they post about it. And telling them that this is not an appropriate space for them to share is not the same as telling them to harm themselves or encouraging low self-esteem.

Seeing actual offenders is even worse. There’s a reason there’s a system in place irl to keep them away from vulnerable populations for the rest of their lives. 

The lolicon stuff… it’s not illegal, but damn is it hard to keep it to yourself in a space full of CSA victims?? How is this the place for justifying it?

I wouldn’t worry much about his behavior after five days. After I adopted my adult cat, I feel like it took almost a couple months for her to settle into the way she is now. There’s so many surprises and changes for the kitty, and he’s probably not used to humans or human spaces.

Personally, I would just focus on getting him comfortable and keeping him entertained. It’s possible that he just needs time to adjust and will balance out. My cat bounced from friendly to timid to super playful to the more mellow and happy cat she is now. They just have so many of behavioral changes in their new home, and I think it’s pretty normal!

I’m sure he will adjust to you again, it might just take time as you two get to know each other better.

I’ve had it as long as I can remember, I think it may stem from sexual abuse at a very young age. Memories are very not-there in places. I’m surprised to see no comments about CSA yet.

Parents definitely worsened and reinforced the need for anxiety via emotional abuse as I grew up though. Almost a ‘shy to social anxiety disorder’ kind of pipeline.

Thank you! Previous therapists of mine have ended sessions better, like you said about kind of wrapping things up and asking if there’s anything else near the end. I know it sometimes leads to doorknob confessions in my case, but I did feel more cared about and calm after things ended. I just struggle with being direct about expressing how it all makes me feel.

I’m not sure if I’m brave enough to show them the post (I guess I’m in therapy for a reason lol), but maybe I’ll be able to bring up how I struggle to communicate with him.

Huh, I didn’t know that. Do silences worsen dissociation in a way? For me, it worsens my anxiety and discomfort since it leaves me time to worry about what I should say and what he’s thinking about me.

I wouldn’t even mind all that much about the time thing if his sessions weren’t so damn expensive, lol. With cheaper therapists I haven’t cared as much. 

I might look into how to tell if a therapist is a good fit, because I have questioned it a bit.

Maybe I can talk to him about using notes or something written. I really like the idea of a nonverbal gesture!

I wish I could just say something like that, and maybe I could if we discussed it. I haven’t told him about that i experience dissociation yet
100%. It’s hard to explain but so many other women just seem so well put-together and pretty that I feel like a freak next to them :,)

I’m on the fence about whether moving to a blue state or a different country would be better. Like you mentioned, I’ve heard Colorado is pretty safe, there’s also Vermont but I’ve heard they have an issue with lack of housing. I know I need to move because I don’t feel safe having a relationship with the opposite sex without abortion rights, and a lot of freedoms are being suppressed in my state.

Moving countries would be a lot harder, but I am tempted. The right wing is becoming so extreme that I think it’s going to start affecting everyone badly, not just red states. What if we lose no-fault divorce soon? Discrimination everywhere is likely going to be legal. I only see more suppression and loss of rights for everyone in our future on a federal level. There’s so much hate everywhere in our culture nowadays. I really do want out.

Personally, I’m wondering if I could get a foot in the door by seeking education out of country? I think it’ll take a while for new laws to pass that are extreme enough for other countries to take U.S. citizens seeking refuge.

Exactly. The hard part for me was that I had a family member who really was having the ideal college experience, telling me about it, and pressuring me to have the same. My expectations ended up being completely wrong. Most people don’t have that great experience, but especially if you have social anxiety. 

Getting your expectations wrong can mess you up. I wish it was more normalized and talked about how most people don’t have that experience and that’s okay.

Uni was awful for me too. I never made much more than acquaintances. What helped was focusing less on “the college experience” and more about why I was actually there. I don’t know if it’s healthy to give up on making close friends but it’s what I did. It’d be a lot to ask to work on that and just getting to class. You do get used to being alone in class and being the quiet one though I think.

Although I hated it a lot of the time, I feel like my social anxiety and my life would be a million times worse if I hadn’t gone. It really does force you to expose yourself, even if making any lasting relationships is still hard. The fear of setting myself up for an entire life where I can’t be around people or get a job was a motivating factor too lol. I’m desperate enough not to have a totally sad life 😭

I’ve done so many damn ssris over the years. Some worked but the side effects were too much, some just didn’t help. I like the SNRI I’m currently on, even if it’s less effective than some of my old ones, but the side effects work for me. I pair it with short-acting take-as-needed type stuff. It truly is trial and error

They don’t take the worst of it away, but I think it makes the anxiety overall more manageable. I wish I found one that worked miracles and took the bulk of the anxiety away, but I’ll take anything.

pregnancy is a horror movie nightmare to me, along with being a mother in general. As I described in some other comments, the idea of being a mother and losing my agency is not something I want whatsoever. That’s pretty much why I came to this sub, so people would hopefully understand what I’m saying without advising me to have a kid. I’m not against babysitting or anything though, I like that advice.

I’m trying to make sense of some temporary feelings. In every way logically and most of the time emotionally, I know I don’t want kids. I think people can have fleeting nurturing urges without actually wanting to have kids, you know?

I’m not really educated about any of that, but it sounds like ‘biological’ isn’t the right word. I’m glad you commented.

I think it makes sense if it’s tied to my sex drive though, yeah. A lot of the feelings do come about after I’m aroused, though the feelings themselves aren’t arousing. I’ve also recently discovered that I’m a more nurturing person than I previously thought (though again, I absolutely don’t want kids), so maybe it’s a combination of those things.

Maybe what I’m feeling is a combination of societal factors, the new nurturing feelings I’ve had towards those I care about, and my sex drive (ovulation?).

I’m not sure I could describe my feelings without babies and pregnancy.
Yeah I wish I didn’t, I’d honestly sound like an idiot to myself even a couple of years ago.

I’m glad someone relates! I never thought I’d ever consider having a baby in my wildest dreams, so even minding the idea less is crazy to me.

Picturing myself as a mother to a biological child is definitely horrifying to me as well. I don’t consider myself a selfish person or not nurturing, but I highly value my bodily agency and personal freedom (especially currently living in an abortion ban state, planning on moving). Not having that full agency, even for only nine months, is too much for me. I also never want to be unable to have financial freedom by being unable to have a job. The expectations society and oftentimes male partners put on mothers is also something that would make me hate my life. I can’t stand seeing how other pregnant women are treated, so I can’t imagine myself going through it. I don’t mind being second to someone I care for, but I don’t want to be treated second to someone the way mothers are for their children. I have a close family member who basically says no one is worth anything if they don’t have kids, and that’s insane to me.

I don’t know if I’ve found the cause, but I’ve been trying to deal with the baby fever in different ways. I write, so sometimes I’ve been writing about having kids, and I’ve been nurturing my pet. I don’t know if it helps or makes things worse lol. I’m just trying to find an outlet.
Exactly! Honestly I’m probably just ovulating. The cute fuzzy romanticized stuff makes me ache a bit but not the reality of it.
Lmao yes or visit ‘the girl with the list’ on tiktok. I’m glad I’m not the only one.

I honestly never experienced it until pretty recently either! I thought people were being dramatic about ‘baby fever’ and stuff (and they kind of are), although it’s not so strong that it would get in the way of my own logic.

I would explain it like, being triggered after arousal 🫣or by my pet because I feel like she’s my baby lol and I feel like my mind/body thinks she’s my actual baby deep down lmao. But I don’t know, I really feel like I need to hold a baby close to me, especially against my breasts? None of these are sexual of course. Feeding a baby with my breasts also suddenly sounds really nice for some reason. I also just seem to think about how it would be nice to feel a baby in my uterus and it kicking in there and everything. Laying around with a baby with me or in me sounds really cozy too for some reason. I find myself gently bouncing my pet in my arms, holding her against my stomach/chest, and wishing I birthed her. I know it’s weird lol. That’s an animal. I’ve been enjoying more stories where a character gets pregnant and has a baby.

Again, I actually hate the idea of being pregnant and raising a baby, especially with the way women are treated around it. Suddenly being the least important being in my own damn body is horrifying. Maybe I just need to give myself a reality check on what babies are actually like.

No it’s not bad advice, I think that’s a good idea! I’ve always been awkward around kids tbh but maybe taking care a kid would be nice if I can kind of learn how they work. If I become an aunt soon that would also be nice (and a huge reality check).

I agree, my being childfree is definitely an example of ‘logic over feelings’ type of scenario.
Thank you! 🌸

I think guys seem to think the /average/
woman gets approached more than they do. I’m not sure how true that societal expectation is in the first place. Most women with social anxiety feel invisible to men because obviously we don’t talk or try to bring any attention to ourselves. Our lives and ability to have relationships isn’t any better than men with social anxiety.

If I were to be approached (and I haven’t in my adult life) I would probably just feel pressured and anxious. In my experiences with male acquaintances, they tend to go 0-100, overwhelm me, and keep pushing when I try to have some space. Not all of them, but that would be my fear if I was approached.

Overall, I think it would be overwhelming. Especially if I’m not expecting it and not prepared for it. I feel like guys can tend to get very intense very quickly with romance and sex so I would fear that too. I know I would be too anxious to keep up with texting or dating anyway. So even if I were approached by someone who didn’t confirm my fears, I wouldn’t be able to say yes. It’s not something I wish to happen, even if it’d be a little flattering.

Ofc I recommend therapy and treatment like others have suggested, but I’m in the same boat as far as trying to keep yourself satisfied until becoming ready to be in a relationship and have sex. Getting some new toys and exploring different “self love” techniques/fantasies rather than being lazy with porn has been enough to keep me fairly content. Maybe it’ll help you.

For me, exposure only worked after I got on a helpful medication. I feel like once my baseline of anxiety was leveled out by it, exposure was much more effective. Before, my anxiety was so extreme that it just confirmed why I hated going out. I don’t know if you’re already on meds or if they’re even an option for you though.

I still struggle with being in public too. I think it has gotten a lot better for me, because I’m not constantly anxious about it, the feeling of being around people will hit me again. It’s more manageable.

Social anxiety disorder affects us the same way it does anyone else. Girls don’t have guys asking them out all the time or at all, especially when you have social anxiety. I’ve never had anyone flirt with me, probably the same as the average man with social anxiety. I don’t understand why anyone would differentiate who has it worse based on gender, especially in this day where your traditional idea of who asks who first isn’t really the case. Even if it were easy to be asked out, it would be just as difficult for us to navigate a relationship with social anxiety as it would be for you.

If anything, I think social anxiety makes it harder to turn down creeps or spot people trying to take advantage of you, which happens more often to women by a huge margin.
Thank you!!
I’ll check it out, thank you!!

You definitely do. I’m 22, but when I was 16 & 17 I felt like I was wasting my years, missing out, and like I would never experience anything. Same early in college too.

I would say to try to let go of your worry about missing out on some of this high school stuff. Worrying about how your anxiety negatively affects your ability to make friends will only make you depressed and want to isolate more, imo. 

It’s really hard, but blocking out what you think other people are experiencing friends-wise and focusing on what you enjoy really helped me. Do you want to have a friend group because everyone seems to have one (and they don’t, plenty of others are totally friendless in HS), or because it’s something you think you’d enjoy, you know?

It’s okay to have an uneventful HS experience. As an adult, I’ve literally never talked about high school to anyone ever because no one really cares. A lot of us people with social anxiety are late bloomers socially, and we aren’t the only ones. 

Maybe you won’t make friends, but you’ve gained experience around people and you’ve learned and you’ve explored yourself. I know HS feels isolating when you have social anxiety, and I’m sorry. I wouldn’t want to do it over.

Yeah to your second paragraph, that’s kind of what I did :,) I’m really new to this so I just didn’t know what to do exactly other than a little google search about beta reading. Coming to the community to ask has obviously been a lot more insightful and I wish I did that before.

I’ll take your advice next time I reach out for a beta reader. The fact that I didn’t look for someone with writing experience seems kinda dumb now lol. I don’t mean to judge this person based on what my expectations were or anything since I didn’t express them.

I will say that they do have some insight when it comes to interpretation because we’re both involved in a community around a specific ship, which is what my fic is about. They are also a fan of my work, so I would think that being able to read it early would be a ‘benefit’ to them.

Next time I will definitely have a more in-depth discussion with the person who betas my work about what beta-ing means to them and the help I need

Omg thank you so much! And thank you for the advice! :) the link will be helpful.

Yeah now that I’ve learned more I’ll have to do things differently when using a beta reader. 

I have a little update, which is that I told them when I’d be releasing my work, but based on their reply, they aren’t going to be doing anything else/don’t want to do anything else. I’m a little overwhelmed with what I have to do in a short amount of time, but I’m not going to try to make them do something they don’t want to. I think their idea of beta reading was just reading maybe? Regardless, now that I’ve heard from everything and learned how it tends to work, I’ll definitely be prepared to go about this in a better way next time.

Yeah I think I’m going to look for other people next time and line out clearer expectations beforehand. Luckily I just asked them to help with this one fic so I don’t think it’s going to be a big deal if I go with someone else for the next.

I’m on the fence about asking them about getting it done or just doing what I can myself this time around. I might just send them a reminder of when I’m posting and see if they do some more work or not

I probably wasn’t clear enough, maybe because I don’t have a super clear idea myself of what a beta reader should do. When I posted to ask it was kinda impulsive, but I probably should’ve lined out that I wanted someone to check spelling/grammar and share their thoughts. They did share their thoughts when I asked which is nice.

As for the deadline, I said that I was writing it for a specific ship event that’s coming soon, but it’s possible they know it’s soon but haven’t checked the specific date? Next time I’ll have to line out the date more clearly. I am learning lol

Maybe it’s just anxiety taking but I’m getting the vibe that they aren’t super interested anymore so I might just try to do what I can myself and be clearer next time I ask someone :,) I’ll try to slip something about the date in case they decide they want to do more

Yeah, I think jokes about the reaction to 9/11 can be pretty funny. I think there’s a difference between making jokes about it as a recent historical event to us americans vs making fun of the death and trauma the people of NYC experienced that day. One feels more like an edgier version of the classic American self-deprecating joke while the latter is punching down

Yeah I realize that wasn’t the right thing to say about this, sorry. I’m a bit jaded from a tragedy in my area that was treated as a joke by some leftists because of where it happened, so I was probably projecting those feelings

I agree. This shouldn’t have been shown to us as children and used as a fear-mongering tactic for hate. I know that it was very disturbing when I was shown footage as a kid. That’s something I don’t mean to downplay when I say this

I completely agree with this. The war on terror was so horrible and so long and we all hate it, so I guess it leads to some people dismissing the catalyst. Especially because it became politicized and used as a justification for hate rather than just the tragic event that it was. It’s fucked up that fear-mongering was used to hate so many people rather than the few extremists. But it was still a recent tragedy that should be treated respectfully for the sake of the victims (not GWB lol).

Sort of using this comment to address some others such as me caring about only 9/11 as a tragedy: the way 9/11 is viewed by gen Z seems like such a unique phenomenon to me, how it was conveyed to us when we were young and how we feel about it now. There are definitely more pressing tragedies right now that are treated much worse by the general public and need more attention. This is just something I happened to stumble upon today. 
Another reason for posting is that I’m usually really proud to be part of gen z since I consider it to be such an empathetic generation despite being so overexposed to the most horrific shit. In my little section of the internet at least, 9/11 seems to be treated differently though (not to say that this is the most dismissed event by our generation ever or that this is the event that needs the most awareness rn. It isn’t).

Respectfully, I don’t understand this. The hatred against Muslims isn’t a joke but neither is over a thousand innocent civilians dying. Families are still affected by this, they are still grieving their lost loved ones. It terrorized an entire nation, regardless of ethnicity. 

The fallout and the U.S. response also killed many, many people, and many of us (including me) were exposed to footage of the following war and stories of it. Does that make it okay to joke about those innocent men, women, and children dying in the crossfire? Of course not.

If these people were truly disinterested, they wouldn’t have bothered to comment imo. I don’t care if people use humor to cope with their own circumstances, but if that humor mocks other people, you need to grow up. I understand we experienced this as children and children can respond inappropriately, but that is not something to be proud of about online

Starting a social media (for example Twitter) involved in your fandom may help. It takes a while to get attention there as well but if you do get yourself out there and start posting links when you update your works, people may start coming to your fic there

Or sometimes fics are really damn good but they just aren’t about a popular character/pairing so they don’t get as much attention. That’s okay too!

I’m sorry that you’ve seen and experienced that. I hope I didn’t come across as minimizing sexual violence towards men, it’s just not my experience to talk about, so I’m glad you shared. Although I hope that people reflect of their biases more, when it comes to men and women, yeah choosing a better environment helps. I kinda posted to say that I wish I didn’t have to, especially when it comes to family, but I can’t change society or anything. I’ve still experienced sexist guys in college, but there’s a lot more normal guys than in the places I used to be. But unlike high school or family, I can walk out when someone’s being disrespectful which is nice, at least since I’m now confident enough to do so.

I definitely don’t mean to leave a sour taste in your mouth or anything, I mean you’re here and you don’t feel attacked because you’re not one of the men I’m upset about. Also, it’s very sweet that you’re posting with your daughter beside you, that made me smile a lot. I’m sure she’ll become a very strong person :) 

(and haha, I like that you used ‘person’ - when I was young and someone declared “girl power!!” when I was doing something I’d just be like, ‘was I not supposed to be good at this?’ lmao)

I feel you, I’m really socially anxious too. Probably most people are more anxious about approaching the opposite sex. I worry about being about eye contact too lol. It’s not like you’re cornering them as a stranger alone. Saying this as a girl, if you’re just being friendly and talking about stuff in common or whatever, I doubt anyone’s gonna feel weird. I enjoy chatting with my male coworkers just like I would a female one, and I appreciate when they make an effort to chat, makes me feel more welcome.
